user.title: Connect to TVT Archive Bridge
user.description: Enter the local address of the host running the TVT Archive container and its access token.

camera.title: Add your first camera
camera.description: TVT Archive tests the camera before saving it. Native TCP/9008 is recommended and includes recorded audio. Recorded RTSP is a video fallback and opens one additional page for its advanced settings.

camera_rtsp.title: Recorded RTSP options
camera_rtsp.description: These settings affect recorded media only. Recording dates and timelines still use the TVT TCP/9008 connection.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or authenticate to the bridge
error.camera_connection_failed: The bridge could not log in to or query this camera. Check its address, TVT TCP port, username, and password.

abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not connect to the TVT Archive bridge

add_camera.title: Add camera
add_camera.description: Native TCP/9008 is recommended and includes recorded audio. Recorded RTSP is a video fallback and opens one additional page for its advanced settings.

edit_camera_details.title: Edit camera
edit_camera_details.description: Leave the password blank to keep it. Native mode needs only this page. Selecting Recorded RTSP opens one additional page for its media settings.

confirm_remove.title: Remove {camera_name}?
confirm_remove.description: This removes the camera from TVT Archive. It does not delete recordings from the camera or recorder.

add_camera_rtsp.title: Recorded RTSP options
add_camera_rtsp.description: These settings affect recorded media only. Recording dates and timelines still use the TVT TCP/9008 connection.

edit_camera_rtsp.title: Edit recorded RTSP options
edit_camera_rtsp.description: These settings affect recorded media only. Recording dates and timelines still use the TVT TCP/9008 connection.

error.camera_connection_failed: The bridge could not log in to or query this camera. Check its address, TVT TCP port, username, and password.
error.camera_remove_failed: The camera could not be removed. Wait for any active playback or download to finish and try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not connect to the TVT Archive bridge
abort.camera_not_found: The selected camera no longer exists
